name: Kalsu

movements.notes: at the start of every minute, until the thrusters are finished
fit them into the rest of each minute

description: One hundred thrusters at 135 lb, with 5 burpees at the start of every minute until the thrusters are done. The score is the total time.
source_notes: CrossFit discussion board thread 'Beware of Kalsu' (board.crossfit.com/archive/index.php/t-54457.html), retrieved 2026-10-16; not on the official Heroes list page, prescription confirmed by every secondary source; the 95-lb women's load is the commonly posted standard
